name: 90/90 Hip Switch
steps: Sit on the floor with your knees bent, feet planted wider than hip-width, and hands braced lightly behind you for support.
Keep your chest tall and lower both knees smoothly to one side until both knees form roughly 90-degree angles.
Pause briefly in the end range, then lift your knees back through center and lower them to the opposite side.
Continue alternating smoothly from side to side through a controlled range for the target duration.
tips: Let your hips rotate smoothly without forcing either knee flat against the floor.
Keep your heels grounded in place as your legs pivot from side to side.
